decisions.reason: Minimum quantity lubrication complements the firm's coolant and machine-tool customer base, and the growing demand for dry and near-dry machining makes it worth keeping at low cost.
The hydrocyclone filter fits the firm's modular filtration platform and core coolant-cleaning business, so dropping it would release few resources.
Gravity band filters are a standard workhorse in coolant filtration and sit squarely within the firm's established offer and spare-parts business.
